content.short: Nefture Security is a Web3 RPC-based firewall that keeps wallets safe and helps users avoid crypto scams.
content.description: Nefture Security delivers a web3 firewall that shields users from scams, hacks, and social engineering. It introduces an RPC-based layer you can add to your wallet, continuously monitoring transactions and automatically blocking those that are fraudulent or suspicious. Many users rely on default or custom RPCs with limited defenses, leaving gaps in protection. By providing this extra safeguard, Nefture Security aims to give blockchain users a safer, more resilient experience in web3 and greater confidence when interacting with decentralized services.
content.meta: Nefture Security is a Web3 security solution with an RPC-based firewall. Discover Nefture Security and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
